chapter: Later years and the Texas scene
title: Visiting graves and shrine of St. Jude
summary: Albert visits relatives' graves and St. Jude's shrine on each trip; his sister recalls selling concert tickets.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: When you come back, you visit your family's graves and the shrines and things in our town?

Yes, I do. You see, I have had so many blessings in my life that I made a promise years ago. And this was through my mother and my sister. I don't know what's happened over the last few years. Every time I'd come here, why, she was ready to go with me. Now she doesn't go. But it's one of the promises that I made. I know she'll listen to what I'm saying. That whenever I come here, I would visit the graves of my relatives and pay them the respect that I owe them. Then visit the shrine that my mother introduced me to. And the shrine, actually, which is my patron saint, St. Jude. Those are the first stops on my agenda. And the next stop is to try to get the test with Dick Allen, which has become a problem.
You can't reach me through too much. Well, your patron saint is a... St. Jude. Patron saint in lost colleges. Right.
Impossible cases. Impossible cases. You might ask my sister why she doesn't go with me anymore. She might have an answer to it. Why you don't visit anymore, is that true? Huh?
I was always pushing this concert.
Because I was selling the tickets. She sold most of the tickets, man. She wanted to know if I was coming.
